Repo: /Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b (Flutter/Dart, Clean Architecture, flutter_bloc, fpdart Either<Failure,T>).

I'm planning implementation of Story 2.4 "Biometric Preference Persistence": a user toggles biometric gating on/off from a new minimal "Configurações" screen; the toggle calls `PATCH /account/settings` (body `{biometricEnabled: bool}`) which is called via `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/account-settings-update` (per this repo's x-cerne-function convention, not the literal REST path); the preference must be re-fetched from the backend (not a stale local cache) on every app load including after reinstall, by calling the SAME PATCH endpoint with an empty body `{}` (there is no GET endpoint — confirmed in docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml, only PATCH `/account/settings` exists, and requirements.md line 158 says the preference is "read and written via PATCH /account/settings"). This fetched/persisted value must then govern whether the vault lock screen (`lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart`) auto-attempts biometric first (current unconditional behavior in `initState`) or skips straight to the PIN keypad. Vault's own repository contract says "Vault makes zero network calls" (see `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart`), so the network fetch of this preference must live in the new `features/account/` module, not inside vault.

I need you to report back (concise, file:line references, no giant code dumps) on:

1. **DI pattern**: Read `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` (or wherever `sl`/`GetIt` is set up) — how are existing repositories/data sources/http client registered (singleton vs factory, `dispose:` callbacks)? How does `features/auth` or `features/vault` get registered (look at `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart` and the equivalent for auth)? Is there a shared Dio/http client instance, and how are headers (`apikey`, `Authorization`) attached currently?

2. **Existing backend-calling feature as a template**: Pick the feature most similar to what account-settings-update needs (probably `features/auth` since it also POSTs/PATCHes to the backend with bearer auth) — show me its data layer shape: remote data source class, DTO (freezed/json_serializable) pattern, how Failure mapping from HTTP errors works (point me at `lib/core/failure/failure.dart` and one concrete mapping site), and how the repository obtains the current user access token to put in the `Authorization: Bearer` header (look at `features/auth/domain` session repository or wherever the access token is stored/exposed).

3. **`Resource<T>` pattern (AD-12)**: epic-2-context.md mentions "the screen uses `Resource<T>` (AD-12) since it is a single-source, single-fetch-lifecycle screen" for a *later* story (8.1), implying this pattern already exists or is referenced somewhere for single-fetch screens. Search the codebase (grep for `Resource<` or `class Resource`) and report whether it exists yet, and if not, how screens currently model loading/error/data state (e.g. does any existing presentation-layer cubit/bloc show a loading->data->error pattern I should mirror for the Configurações screen's initial fetch?).

4. **Current placeholder screen**: Read `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`'s `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (full content) and how it's wired in `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` (already know route path `/configuracoes`, builder at line ~92). I need to know exactly what to replace/remove.

5. **Design tokens for a toggle/switch**: grep `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` for any switch/toggle-related tokens, and check `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` section 3 (just grep for "toggle" or "switch") for whether a toggle component's visual spec already exists. Also check if any existing widget in `lib/core/widgets/` already implements a styled switch/toggle I should reuse (grep `lib/core/widgets/` for "Switch").

6. **vault_injection.dart governing "biometric-first vs PIN-only"**: Read `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart` fully and `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart`'s constructor signature. I need to know the cleanest seam to inject a "should attempt biometric first" bool/preference into either the vault repository or directly into `VaultLockScreen`'s construction (in `app_router.dart`'s `GoRoute` builder for `/vault`) without vault itself making a network call. Report the constructor signatures and where `VaultLockScreen(vaultRepository: vaultRepository)` is instantiated in `app_router.dart`.

7. **main.dart / bootstrap**: Read `lib/main.dart` (or wherever DI bootstrap + `buildAppRouter` is called) to see the app startup sequence — where would an async fetch of the biometric preference (via the new account repository) fit before/around building the router, given session token may not be ready yet at boot? Report the relevant bootstrap code structure concisely.

Give me a single consolidated report under ~700 words, organized by these 7 numbered points, each with concrete file:line references I can open directly. Do not propose a design yourself — just report what exists.

    99	/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:

   101	/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
   102	/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every

   104	///   `authenticated` (bounced home below — `/reauth` is meant to be
   105	///   reached only by the expiry overlay's own explicit navigation while
   106	///   `expired`, code review Story 1.6) — a mid-session expiry never
   107	///   navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the three
   108	///   non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
   109	///
   110	/// AD-14: Epic 2's `VaultStatus` gate (RF03) is composed first, strictly
   111	/// ahead of every `SessionStatus` check below — the vault gate overrides
   112	/// any location whenever it isn't `unlocked`, and only once it is does the
   113	/// rest of this function (unchanged from Story 1.6) ever run.
   114	String? _redirect(
   115	  VaultRepository vaultRepository,
   116	  SessionRepository sessionRepository,
   117	  GoRouterState state,
   118	) {
   119	  final location = state.matchedLocation;
   120	
   121	  // AD-14 — checked before SessionStatus, per Boundaries ("`_redirect`
   122	  // checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`"). `VaultStatus.locked` is
   123	  // the default from construction (never `null`), so this never waits on
   124	  // an async warm-up the way the `status == null` boot check below does.
   125	  if (vaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked) {
   126	    return location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock
   127	        ? null
   128	        : AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
   132	
   133	  if (status == null) {
   134	    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
   135	  }
   136	
   137	  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
   138	    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
   139	  }
   140	
   141	  // status is authenticated or expired.
   142	  // `vaultLock` is included here too: once the vault unlocks while this
   143	  // location is still `/vault` (the normal cold-start path once
   144	  // `authenticate()` succeeds), the same fall-through that already bounces
   145	  // `/boot`/`/auth` to Home applies — `/vault` is never a valid resting
   146	  // place once `VaultStatus.unlocked`.
   147	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot ||
   148	      location == AppRoutePaths.auth ||
   149	      location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock) {
   150	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
   151	  }
   152	  // `/reauth` is a throwaway placeholder standing in for Epic 2's real
   153	  // reauth flow; it should never be sitting open once the session is back
   154	  // to fully `authenticated` (code review, Story 1.6).
   155	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.reauth &&

   162	/// Wraps [streams] as a single `Listenable` so `GoRouter`'s
   163	/// `refreshListenable` can re-run [_redirect] on every emission from either

   167	/// the one session stream), composing them into the one `Listenable`
   168	/// `GoRouter` itself requires (Boundaries: "never a second
   169	/// `GoRouter`/`redirect`").
   170	class _GoRouterRefreshStream extends ChangeNotifier {

   180	          onError: (_, _) {},

   185	  late final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _subscriptions;

   187	  @override

   189	    for (final subscription in _subscriptions) {
   190	      subscription.cancel();
   191	    }
   192	    super.dispose();
   193	  }

     6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
     7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
     8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
     9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
    10	///
    11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
    12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
    13	@freezed
    14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
    15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
    16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
    17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
    18	      NetworkTimeout;
    19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
    20	      NetworkOffline;
    21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
    22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
    23	      PiiCheckFailed;
    24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
    25	      EmbeddingFailed;
    26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
    27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
    28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
    29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
    30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
    31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
    32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
    33	      PayloadTooLarge;
    34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
    35	
    36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
    37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
    38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
    39	      MalformedResponse;
    40	
    41	  const Failure._();

    43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
    44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
    45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
    46	        NetworkTimeout() => true,
    47	        NetworkOffline() => true,
    48	        PiiCheckFailed() => true,
    49	        EmbeddingFailed() => true,
    50	        AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
    51	        RateLimited() => true,
    52	        AuthExpired() ||
    53	        AuthInvalid() ||
    54	        Validation() ||
    55	        NotFound() ||

    67	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {

    69	        'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
    70	        'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
    71	        'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
    72	        'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
